about_the_game:
Overview

Divine Ruins is a mythological puzzle–adventure game set within the forgotten temples of ancient gods.

Play alone or with a friend as a cursed soul condemned by the divine, trapped in the ruins where gods once walked.

Uncover the secrets of each temple — each one a reflection of a different deity’s domain and wrath.

Gameplay

Explore sacred chambers filled with mysteries, solve environmental puzzles, and piece together the story of a world ruled by divine punishment.

Every ruin tells a fragment of the truth — a story of rebellion, faith, and redemption.

Work together with your partner to overcome intricate mechanisms and uncover the meaning behind the gods’ silence.

Key Features

  • 1–2 Player Experience: Face the challenge alone or share the journey with a friend in full co-op play.

  • Mythological Puzzles: Each room represents a god and introduces unique logic and environmental challenges.

  • Atmospheric Storytelling: Immersive sound design, haunting music, and cinematic moments bring the ruins to life.

  • Environmental Interaction: Examine symbols, move ancient mechanisms, and activate divine structures to progress.

  • Dark Fantasy World: Explore a realm where light fades and the boundaries between mortals and gods blur.

  • Linear but Deep Narrative: Progress through interconnected chambers, each revealing more of your past and the gods’ forgotten truths.

Themes & Atmosphere

Inspired by ancient Greek mythology, Divine Ruins explores themes of loneliness, faith, and the weight of divine judgment.

Echoes of past prayers fill the halls — and every solved puzzle brings you closer to the truth of your curse.

In Short

Divine Ruins is a story-driven puzzle adventure about the bond between mortals and gods.

Will you escape the divine curse — or become part of it?
